tagline: A baroque old town that launches hot-air balloons from its centre — home to Užupis, a self-declared republic with its own constitution.
overview: Vilnius is the Baltic capital that feels like a secret: one of Europe's largest baroque old towns, crowned by Gediminas Tower on its forested hill and crowned in turn by hot-air balloons drifting over the rooftops — one of few capitals that let them launch downtown.

Across the river sits Užupis — 'the republic beyond the river' — a district that declared itself independent on April Fools' Day 1997. It has its own flag, anthem and constitution (Article 12: 'a dog has the right to be a dog'). The angel statue watches over cafés and artists' studios.
Speed's 2024 tour streamed from Vilnius. The city also anchors the 'geographical centre of Europe' marker a short drive north — and its pink-soup šaltibarščia (cold beet soup) is a summer icon.

funFacts.title: A REPUBLIC INSIDE
funFacts.text: Užupis declared independence in 1997 — with a constitution guaranteeing dogs' rights.

funFacts.title: BALLOONS OVER THE OLD TOWN
funFacts.text: Vilnius is among the only European capitals allowing balloons to launch in the centre.

funFacts.title: BAROQUE HEAVEN
funFacts.text: The old town is one of Northern Europe's largest — 1,200+ buildings of baroque and gothic.

funFacts.title: THE TOWER ON THE HILL
funFacts.text: Gediminas Tower, all that remains of the upper castle, flies the flag the freedom marchers raised.

funFacts.title: CENTRE OF EUROPE
funFacts.text: A marker 26km north claims the geographic midpoint of the continent.

funFacts.title: PINK SOUP
funFacts.text: Šaltibarščia — cold beet-buttermilk soup — is electric pink and beloved.

funFacts.title: THE GATE OF DAWN
funFacts.text: The 16th-century gate houses a revered Madonna icon — pilgrims kneel in the street.

funFacts.title: A HILL OF CROSSES FAR
funFacts.text: The Hill of Crosses — 200,000 crosses — is a pilgrimage site up north.

funFacts.title: JEWISH JERUSALEM
funFacts.text: Vilnius was once called 'the Jerusalem of Lithuania' for its scholarly Jewish community.

funFacts.title: CEPELINAI
funFacts.text: The national dish — potato zeppelins stuffed with meat — is named for airship shape.
